title: Gated Concept Adapters: Layer-Wise Concept Bottlenecks for Auditable Text Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.32600v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human-facing text understanding systems are used to infer affect, moderate harmful content, and support socially sensitive decisions. However, Transformer predictions are difficult to audit because they are produced from high-dimensional hidden states that do not provide a compact, inspectable interface for human analysis or intervention. We introduce Gated Concept Adapters (GCA), a layer-wise concept bottleneck framework that attaches gated, low-dimensional concept-producing readout adapters to selected outputs of pretrained Transformers. Token representations are mapped into concept activations, filtered by learned gates, pooled into layer-level summaries, and exposed to the prediction head as a concept-mediated interface. The dimensions can be inspected through usage statistics, signature n-grams, post-hoc concept names, and targeted concept interventions. translated_title: 门控概念适配器：用于可审计文本理解的分层概念瓶颈
translated_abstract: 面向人类的文本理解系统被用于推断情感、审核有害内容以及支持社会敏感的决策。然而，Transformer的预测难以审计，因为其预测产生于高维隐藏状态，无法为人类分析或干预提供紧凑、可检查的接口。我们提出了门控概念适配器（Gated Concept Adapters, GCA），这是一种分层概念瓶颈框架，它将带门控的、低维的概念生成读出适配器附加到预训练Transformer的选定输出上。词元表示被映射为概念激活，经学习到的门控过滤，汇聚为层级别的摘要，并作为概念中介接口暴露给预测头。这些维度可以通过使用统计、特征性n-gram、事后概念命名以及针对性的概念干预来进行检查。我们在细粒度情感分类、毒性检测等任务上对GCA进行了评估……
tldr: 提出了门控概念适配器（GCA）这一分层概念瓶颈框架，通过在预训练Transformer的选定层附加门控低维概念读出适配器，将隐藏状态转化为可检查、可干预的概念中介接口，从而实现可审计的文本理解。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Gated Concept Adapters (GCA), a layer-wise concept bottleneck framework that attaches gated low-dimensional concept-producing readout adapters to pretrained Transformers, converting hidden states into an inspectable, intervention-capable concept-mediated interface for auditable text understanding.
